CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.previous: the generic enemy interpreter switched a raw ushort over ~170 constants of several catalogs, owner opcodes behind when guards
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.type: CommonEnemyInstruction plus per-owner instruction enums (27 new families, Ridley, Ceres steam/door, Mama Turtle, Kraid arm, Phantoon part; existing owner enums reused)
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.closedProof: no owner opcode shares a value with a common opcode (asserted by VerifyEnemyInstructionCodePointerCatalogs); owner guards are disjoint
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.transitions: none; instruction words are immutable stream data
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.boundary: ProcessInstructions: common membership, then TryProcessOwnedEnemyInstruction; unowned words throw as before
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.invalidValues: typed switches throw InvalidOperationException; untranslated words keep the InvalidDataException
CommonEnemyInstructionCodes, EnemyInstru.tests: catalog uniqueness/invariant check; all five movie replays

EnemyProjectileCodePointers, DownwardGat.previous: projectile pre-instruction dispatcher switched a raw ushort over constants of four catalogs
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, DownwardGat.closedProof: the dispatcher already threw for any other word
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, DownwardGat.transitions: pre-instruction slot words written as (ushort) members
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, DownwardGat.boundary: RunEnemyProjectilePreInstruction decodes the slot word after the Tourian handler
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, DownwardGat.tests: projectile catalog coverage test walks the enum; movie replays

EnemyProjectileCodePointers, KagoBugProj.previous: projectile instruction interpreter switched a raw ushort over two catalogs
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, KagoBugProj.closedProof: the interpreter already threw for any other word
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, KagoBugProj.invalidValues: Decode throws InvalidDataException; guarded cases fall to the throwing default as before
EnemyProjectileCodePointers, KagoBugProj.tests: projectile catalog coverage test; movie replays
